entry.title: Research Summary: September 24, 2026
entry.summary: This section is anchored by the Hermes Agent v0.21.4 release (21 September 2026), which adds a --format stream-json CLI flag for structured output alongside a rollup of merged PRs covering skills auto-load and MCP discovery concurrency — the freshest, most directly actionable news for Hermes users. Two companion deep-dives cover the Hermes-Claude subscription plugin: its end-to-end request pipeline with process isolation driving the unmodified official Claude CLI, and its credential model where auth lives entirely inside the official Claude Code CLI (no API keys handled by Hermes) — essential trust-and-setup reading for the plugin's growing user base. Rounding out the ecosystem: Microsoft Agent Framework 1.19.0 (18 September 2026) hardens MCP security with per-invocation session scoping and adds vector-store connectors, relevant for teams building across agent SDKs; and AgentProto, a new open-source TypeScript runtime that integrates Hermes as one of 14 supported coding agents, signaling Hermes's expanding interoperability in the broader agent orchestration landscape.
